goblin-citizen.summary: The model is a friendly green goblin trader with a big sack, a cap, a vest, striped pants, and a brass bell. It is the same character as the mockup, with clear differences in the head covering and the face.
strengths: The costume colors match the mockup: orange scarf, brown vest, cream shirt, red sash, purple striped pants, and red pointed shoes.
The big sack with scrolls, pots, a lantern, and a tin reads as a junk trader from the side and the back.
The bell hangs from the fist with the mouth down, as in the mockup.
The large ears and the sack make a clear silhouette in all 8 sprite directions, and the face reads in the front sprites.
issues: The face has an open mouth with one fang. The mockup has a closed wide smile. Close the mouth into a wide smile.
The head covering is a smooth orange cap. The mockup has a yellow cloth wrap with folds and a knot. Change the cap to a yellow wrap with a knot.
The nose is a small button. The mockup has a long, large goblin nose. Make the nose longer and larger.
No straps show on the chest. The mockup shows brown straps over the vest. Add two straps from the sack over the shoulders.
The bell is at cheek height. The mockup holds the bell up near the top of the head. Lift the bell arm higher.
The walk keeps the bell arm still, and the legs move only a small distance. The motion is stiff.
goblin-citizen.next: Close the mouth into a wide smile and change the cap to a yellow cloth wrap with a knot.

lizardfolk-citizen.summary: The model is a green lizardfolk with a teal headband, a shell necklace, a cream vest, and a pink spiral shell in a raised hand. It is the same character as the mockup, but the face, the body proportions, and the crest are noticeably different.
strengths: The raised spiral shell and the open waving hand match the mockup pose and read well at 128 px.
The yellow eyes, the pink blush, and the white shell necklace match the mockup.
The long tail and the teal headband give a clear silhouette from the side and the back.
The shell sits on the hand, and all parts are attached.
issues: The face does not show the warm closed smile of the mockup. The mouth is a flat line with small teeth, and the brow ridges make the eyes look stern. Add a wide curved smile and lift the brows.
The body is tall and narrow on long straight legs. The mockup is short and squat, with a round belly and wide bent legs. Make the torso shorter and rounder and the legs shorter.
The crest is a hard orange block that looks like a brick from the side. The mockup has a soft fan of tapered spines. Change the crest to a fan of 3 to 5 tapered spines.
The mockup has a rope collar, a teal neckerchief, and cream belly plates. The model has a knit cream vest and no collar. Add the rope collar and show the belly plates.
The snout is short and flat. The mockup has a longer, rounded snout. Make the snout longer.
The scale pattern covers the full body and the face with the same strong cracks. The mockup skin is smooth. Make the scale bump weaker, mainly on the face.
The walk keeps both arms still, and the legs move only a small distance. The motion is stiff.
lizardfolk-citizen.next: Change the face to a wide closed smile with relaxed brows.
